instruction: Download the image from "https://huggingface.co/datasets/xlangai/ubuntu_osworld_file_cache/resolve/main/multi_apps/3c8f201a-009d-4bbe-8b65-a6f8b35bb57f/kingbird.jpeg", then use GIMP to save it in WebP format as "bird.webp" on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "alt", "t"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires downloading JPEG and converting to WebP format. Custom metric verifies file exists and is readable.

llm_judge_reasons: Metric only checks file extension (.webp) but does NOT verify actual file format
Cannot distinguish between renamed JPEG and properly converted WebP file
Instruction explicitly requires GIMP conversion to WebP format, not just file renaming
A user could simply rename kingbird.jpeg to bird.webp and receive full credit
Missing validation of actual WebP file format (magic bytes, image parsing, etc.)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add file magic byte verification (WebP files start with 'RIFF' and contain 'WEBP' marker)
Or use image library (PIL/Pillow) to attempt opening as WebP and verify format
Or compare file signature against known WebP format specifications
Ensure metric validates actual format conversion occurred, not just extension change
